digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI workflows, gate guard discipline
propositions: The predates-gate guard shell pattern appears 24 times across six workflow files and has drifted in at least two documented bugs, requiring a single invariant owner to prevent future divergence.

Two existing gate consolidations (shared resolver and shared enabled-check) cannot be folded into a third because the construct cannot move into a shared repo file—it must remain inline in each workflow to function on pre-gate trees.

Every gate step invoking a repo-local script must carry either an `-f <path>` guard with the canonical message or a mandatory-reason `# predates-gate-ok:` marker; steps dropping their guard or markers without reasons must be caught by automated tests.

Four sites carry behavior a bare skip would silently drop (matrix output, dual generators, inverted guard forms, data file sorting) and must preserve their current bodies while accepting guard-only inspection.

Seven gate steps are currently unguarded; five are genuinely guard-free with recorded reasons, and two are gaps filed and linked as `discovered_from` this ticket rather than fixed here, because adding a guard changes which gates run on old bases.
